page.meta_description: The Avatar State is the glowing, overwhelming form in which Aang channels prior Avatars; if he dies in it, the cycle ends. Related pages: Aang.
page.content:
Channel of every past Avatar's power — and a single point of failure.

How Avatar State connects

  • Character: Aang — Aang enters the Avatar State when past lives seize the fight.

What is Avatar State?

The Avatar State is the glowing, overwhelming form in which Aang channels prior Avatars; if he dies in it, the cycle ends.

Key threads lead to Aang.
